args.subject: Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail — great weekend hike
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend the Cascade Falls Trail in the national park — it’s a perfect option for a weekend hike. The trail is about 3 miles round trip and features beautiful waterfall views along the route. It’s relatively short but very scenic.

If you want directions or want to go together this weekend, let me know.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: Alex — Personal Trainer
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Alex — they're a wonderful personal trainer at the gym on Main Street. Alex is great at creating customized workout plans tailored to individual goals, is very motivating, and works well with all fitness levels. I highly recommend them if you're looking for a trainer.

Let me know if you'd like an introduction.

Thanks,

args.subject: Recommendation: Sarah — Piano Teacher
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Sarah as a piano teacher. She’s a fantastic instructor who specializes in classical music and has over 15 years of teaching experience. She’s patient, works well with students of all levels, and has a strong track record preparing students for recitals and exams.

If you’d like, I can share her contact information or help set up an introduction.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: FitTrack fitness app
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend a fitness app called FitTrack. It's really helpful for tracking workouts and has great meal-planning features. It makes logging exercises and monitoring progress simple, and the customizable meal plans are excellent if you want help with nutrition alongside your workouts.

Thought you might find it useful!

Best regards,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery downtown
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM, so if you want fresh loaves, be sure to go early.

Hope you enjoy it!

Best,
[Your Name]
